coverage.note: No publisher system card or model card exists for Raptor mini. summary: Raptor mini has no publisher card and is retired in the catalog. GitHub's changelog describes it only as a new experimental Copilot model rolling out in Visual Studio Code for Pro, Pro+, and Free users, with selection in chat, ask, edit, and agent modes. The catalog records lineage to a fine-tuned GPT-5 mini, but this digest does not import GPT-5 mini results or safety findings to Raptor mini.

points.text: GitHub's changelog says Raptor mini was a new experimental model rolling out in GitHub Copilot to Pro, Pro+, and Free plans in Visual Studio Code.
The changelog says users could select it in the Visual Studio Code Copilot Chat model picker for chat, ask, edit, and agent modes.
The rollout was gradual, so the changelog explicitly warned that some users might not see the model immediately.
